body: Note for reviewers: There's a bunch of review comments in the "hidden items". I wish GitHub provided a way to bypass codeowners for specific PRs so we don't get so much noise from assigning and unassigning 20+ teams.

> I like the idea of this a LOT, but from past experience with these options I'd say there's room to formalize matters even further. In particular: we should take advantage of `SortPriority`, to allow for ordering within a group without causing spaces. For example, the following would solve the gap issue for `*.compat.inc`:
> 
> ```diff
>    - Regex: ^".*\.compat\.inc"$
> -    Priority: 1
> +    Priority: 0
> +    SortPriority: 1
> ```

I swear I had tried that and didn't get the expected result (a month ago or so, I forgot the details). But I must have made a mistake back then, I tried now and this indeed makes it work as we want it.

*Edit:* Nevermind, it works as long as there's no `Priority: 1`. I'll follow @Shadows-of-Fire's suggestion and use 10-increments for `Priority` so we can sprinkle some intermediate `SortPriority` if needed.
